targets.title: International diversification and firm performance: the S-curve hypothesis.
targets.evidence_quote:
We revisit the empirical relationship between multinationality and perfor-
                            mance by attempting to replicate the widely cited S-shape relationship reported in Lu and Beamish
                            (2004).
targets.outcome_quote:
Using a longitudinal and comprehensive database on the population of U.S. MNCs from
                            1989 to 2007, we find no evidence of an S-shaped relationship; nor do we see a moderating effect
                            of intangible assets.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly find neither the S-shaped relationship nor the proposed moderating effect in their new US sample.
